title: 德州如何赢得太空竞赛
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For most of space white history, NASA and government or nation states were really the biggest players in charge.
segments.zh: 在太空探索的多数历史中，NASA和政府或国家才是真正的主导者。

segments.en: That has recently shifted. This was in front here we really believed for a long time. It was only a place for governments to build and innovate.
segments.zh: 但最近情况变了。我们曾长期认为太空只是政府建造和创新的领域。

segments.en: What we're seeing is a democratized space sector with a lot of smaller players and a lot of larger commercial players as well.
segments.zh: 如今我们看到太空领域民主化，涌现出许多小型和大型商业参与者。

segments.en: With the global space economy currently valued at over $650 billion, one American state in particular is betting big on this rapidly growing sector.
segments.zh: 全球太空经济估值超6500亿美元，美国一个州正大力押注这一快速增长领域。

segments.en: Governor Abbott coming to you from the great state of Texas.
segments.zh: 阿博特州长来自伟大的得克萨斯州。

segments.en: Texas is a really good snapshot of the new direction that the space industry is taking.
segments.zh: 得州是太空产业新方向的绝佳缩影。

segments.en: There's a huge space community that's just embedded in Texas.
segments.zh: 得州深深植根着一个庞大的太空社区。

segments.en: From a NASA standpoint because of that competition, they're lowering the overall cost that allows us to be able to do more.
segments.zh: 从NASA角度看，竞争降低了整体成本，让我们能做更多事。

segments.en: Three, two, one, and lift off.
This is where we do the majority of all of our rocket testing, engine testing, component level testing, 200 acres of a factory floor and engine test and machine shop.
segments.zh: 我们在这里进行大部分火箭测试、发动机测试、部件测试，还有200英亩的工厂、发动机测试区和机加工车间。

segments.en: Firefly Aerospace is one of many commercial space companies that has set up in Texas.
segments.zh: 萤火虫航空航天是在德克萨斯州落户的众多商业航天公司之一。
